names.legendary: Captain Schipp of the Black Barge

lore.common: Barks at every boat that dares to sail past its window, even toy boats in the bath.
lore.uncommon: Rides at the front of the canal barge and barks orders the boatman pretends to follow.
lore.rare: Patrols the deck so thoroughly that not a single crumb has ever reached the river.
lore.epic: Chased one rat the full length of a cargo ship, through every cabin. The crew found the rat asleep in the captain's hat.
lore.legendary: Was made honorary harbour master of the whole canal. Every barge must now stop, show its sandwiches and wait to be sniffed.

lore.common: Refuses to walk in the rain, the wind or any direction you suggest.
lore.uncommon: Trots along with its nose in the air as if it owns the pavement, the street and the town.
lore.rare: Dug up the castle lawn hunting one mole, then presented the hole to the gardener as a gift.
lore.epic: Barked at a bagpipe until it stopped. The whole Highland band now plays only when the terrier is asleep.
lore.legendary: Was offered the keys to the castle and turned them down because the castle was not tidy enough.

lore.common: Lies across the entire sofa with its long legs, then sighs when you ask for a corner.
lore.uncommon: Walks so softly on its long legs that the sheep don't notice it until it says hello.
lore.rare: Can outrun the wind on a highland hill, then stops to sniff a single flower.
lore.epic: Stood up to say hello and rested its chin on the roof of the bus. The bus waited politely until it had finished.
lore.legendary: Was asked to carry a message from one end of the Highlands to the other. Arrived before the sender had finished writing it.

lore.common: Its eyebrows are so bushy that it has to lift them to see what it is barking at.
lore.uncommon: Pulls silly faces until everyone at the table laughs and drops a sausage.
lore.rare: Can squeeze into any badger hole, then refuses to come out until it has been offered a snack.
lore.epic: Went down a badger sett in a white coat and came out brown. The badgers now think it is one of them and send it party invitations.
lore.legendary: Was appointed official jester of a Welsh castle. Has never repeated a joke, mainly because it can't remember them.

names.legendary: Sheltie Belle of the Northern Isles

lore.common: Barks at every leaf that falls in autumn and treats each one as an emergency.
lore.uncommon: Herds the ducks on the pond into a neat queue, then looks back for applause.
lore.rare: Herds the children at every birthday party into one corner of the garden, then barks until the cake comes out.
lore.epic: Rounded up every pony on the island and parked them by size, from smallest to slightly less small.
lore.legendary: Herded the ferry passengers into a queue so neat that the island ferry now leaves early every single day.

names.legendary: Princess Shih of the Golden Pillow

lore.common: Its topknot droops over its eyes until someone ties it up with a ribbon. Then it sulks about the ribbon.
lore.uncommon: Waddles regally through the house as if expecting servants to open every door.
lore.rare: Its silky coat sweeps the floor so well that the house has not needed hoovering in a year.
lore.epic: Snored so loudly through the wedding dinner that the band played along to keep in time.
lore.legendary: Was given its own wing of the palace, its own garden and its own chef. Still sleeps in the laundry basket.

lore.common: Complains loudly and dramatically when you say "bath". And "walk". And "hello".
lore.uncommon: Digs a cool hole in the flowerbed on every warm day and lies in it like it's on holiday.
lore.rare: Its pale blue eyes stare so deep into your soul that you give it half your sandwich.
lore.epic: Led a sled team in the wrong direction because it smelled sausages. The race now has a new finish line.
lore.legendary: Escaped from every kennel, garden and fenced field in the country, then came home to howl about how boring it all was.

lore.common: Barks at the kookaburra every morning. The kookaburra laughs back, and it has never once won.
lore.uncommon: Its blue-and-tan coat shines so smoothly that people think it has been ironed.
lore.rare: Faces down snakes in the outback with a stern little bark. The snakes slither off embarrassed.
lore.epic: Chased a whole flock of cockatoos off the school roof. They moved onto the headmaster's car instead.
lore.legendary: Had its silky coat brushed so long and straight that the town theatre hired it as the curtain. Takes a bow every night.

lore.common: Jumps up to kiss your face every time you come home, even if you only went to the bin.
lore.uncommon: Its coat is so soft that strangers ask to stroke it, and it always says yes.
lore.rare: Its coat frizzes into a cloud in the rain, so on wet days the farmer keeps trying to shear it.
lore.epic: Shook itself dry after a swim at the summer fair and frizzed every hairdo at the bandstand.
lore.legendary: Said hello so hard at the airport that every plane had to circle until it calmed down.

lore.common: Wags its whole body so hard that it falls over at the end of every greeting.
lore.uncommon: Watches over the children at the playground and sits beside anyone who looks lonely.
lore.rare: Grins so widely that strangers grin back, then carries a whole log home from the park in that grin.
lore.epic: Played so happily on the sofa that the sofa is now in two pieces.
lore.legendary: Pulled a broken-down bus up a hill to the school gates and then asked every child for a pat.

lore.common: Its fancy haircut takes two hours at the groomer and is ruined in one puddle.
lore.uncommon: Retrieves ducks from the lake, then dries its pompoms under the hand dryer at the café.
lore.rare: Can solve any puzzle toy in seconds and then hides the treats for later.
lore.epic: Shook its pompoms dry at the lakeside café and every customer got a free shower.
lore.legendary: Swam across the lake, won the show and was home before tea, without a single curl out of place.

lore.common: Barks at the dishwasher every time it beeps, then waits for it to apologise.
lore.uncommon: Seems to understand every word you say and pretends not to hear the word "bath".
lore.rare: Cleared the farm of rats, foxes and one very surprised badger in a single morning.
lore.epic: Guarded the whole farmyard so carefully that the hens now ask it before laying an egg.
lore.legendary: Took charge of a sleepy village, kept every gate shut and every hen counted, and was made sheriff without a vote.

lore.common: Always looks deeply worried, even while eating its favourite biscuit.
lore.uncommon: Barks quietly to itself while hunting, as if it is narrating a nature programme.
lore.rare: Pushed through a thorn hedge that every other dog refused to touch, then frowned at the thorns.
lore.epic: Frowned so seriously at the village fete that the coconut shy closed early out of respect.
lore.legendary: Was named the most serious dog in history after attending a hundred birthday parties without once smiling. It enjoyed them all.

names.legendary: Old Thundermane, Keeper of the Pass

lore.common: Sleeps all day and barks all night, so the house is never sure whose schedule it is on.
lore.uncommon: Has a mane like a lion and a sense of dignity to match. Refuses to wear a raincoat.
lore.rare: Guarded a mountain village so well that the snow leopards sent a letter of complaint.
lore.epic: Barked once in the high valley and the echo knocked the snow off every roof.
lore.legendary: Guarded one mountain gate so faithfully that it now checks tickets for the whole range. Even the snow needs a pass.

lore.common: Its big flat feet act like snowshoes, so it walks on top of the snow and laughs at you sinking.
lore.uncommon: Is considered lucky, so people keep patting it before exams.
lore.rare: Climbed a frozen cliff that the goats wouldn't try, just to look back and wag.
lore.epic: Shook its shaggy coat in the village square and caused a small snowstorm.
lore.legendary: Brought so much luck to a mountain village that every lost key in the valley turned up the same afternoon.

lore.common: Rides in a handbag everywhere and complains if the handbag doesn't match.
lore.uncommon: Prances along the pavement on its tiptoes as if the ground is slightly beneath it.
lore.rare: Learned to open the treat cupboard and now runs the kitchen.
lore.epic: Twirled so beautifully at the dog show that the ice dancers asked for lessons.
lore.legendary: Taught itself to walk on its back legs so well that it queues at the bakery on its own, and the baker now bows back.

lore.common: Shivers on a warm day, under a blanket, by the fire, and still asks for your jumper.
lore.uncommon: Hears a mouse in the attic from the garden and runs in to report it.
lore.rare: Its ears are so big and pointy that they pick up the radio. It barks along to the weather forecast.
lore.epic: Barked so loudly at a burglar that the burglar ran into the police station to ask for protection.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole castle free of mice for its entire life. Was given a tiny castle of its own as thanks.

lore.common: Follows you from room to room, including the bathroom, and looks offended when you close the door.
lore.uncommon: Its golden-rust coat glows in the sunshine, so it is easy to spot sitting on your favourite chair.
lore.rare: Points at a pheasant with such focus that it forgets to blink for five minutes.
lore.epic: Ran through a whole country estate so fast that the gardeners thought a comet had landed.
lore.legendary: Pointed at a pheasant from a hot-air balloon and held the point so hard that the balloon drifted over to it. The pheasant was very surprised.

lore.common: Bays at the moon, the street lamp and the neighbour's porch light. It's not fussy.
lore.uncommon: Runs so fast after a scent that it overtakes the hunters, their horses and their lunch.
lore.rare: Its voice carries so far that people two valleys away come to see who's lost.
lore.epic: Followed one scent so fast through the county that it arrived at the picnic before the picnic did.
lore.legendary: Treed a raccoon so often that the raccoon now leaves a note on the tree saying where it has gone.

lore.common: Leans against your legs during dinner and stares with its amber eyes until you share.
lore.uncommon: Its silver coat makes it look like a ghost in the early morning mist. The postman runs.
lore.rare: Opened the fridge with its nose and left it open, so the whole kitchen is now the same temperature as the milk.
lore.epic: Raided the counter at a wedding and ate the top tier of the cake. Every photo shows a grey dog wearing icing.
lore.legendary: Learned to open every door in the office building, then let the whole street's dogs in for a meeting in the boardroom.

lore.common: Springs into every bush on the walk, then comes out looking surprised that it was a bush.
lore.uncommon: Its red-and-white coat makes it look like a little dragon. It plays along.
lore.rare: Flushes every bird out of the hedge, then politely waits for them to settle back in.
lore.epic: Sprang into a hedge maze and out the other side, straight through. The maze now has a dog-shaped shortcut.
lore.legendary: Was adopted as the mascot of a whole country's rugby team and bounced so hard after a win that the stadium shook.

names.legendary: Wee Hamish, Digger of the Highlands

lore.common: Digs a hole in the flowerbed, sits in it and waits to be photographed.
lore.uncommon: Its white coat stays white for exactly one minute after a bath.
lore.rare: Squeezed down a rabbit hole and came up in the neighbour's greenhouse holding a tomato.
lore.epic: Got so muddy at the Highland Games that it took the whole pipe band to wash it. The bagpipes were full of bubbles.
lore.legendary: Dug a tunnel straight through a Highland hill to get to the other side faster. The hill is now a short cut.

lore.common: Sprints round the garden at top speed for one minute, then sleeps for six hours.
lore.uncommon: Shivers under two blankets and asks for a third.
lore.rare: Runs so fast that it reaches the ball before it has stopped bouncing.
lore.epic: Wore a woolly jumper to the beach on the hottest day of the year and still asked for a towel to lie on.
lore.legendary: Ran a lap of the track so fast that it lapped itself and got confused about who had won.

names.legendary: Aurora, White Queen of the Ice

lore.common: Howls whenever the freezer door is opened because it smells like home.
lore.uncommon: Blends into the snow so perfectly that it sneaks up on its own pack.
lore.rare: Can cross a frozen lake without a single crack, while the polar bears are still testing the ice.
lore.epic: Howled so loudly over the Arctic that the icebergs drifted closer to listen.
lore.legendary: Howled on the longest night of the winter, and the northern lights came out to see who was making that noise.

lore.common: Bounces straight up and down like a spring until somebody throws the ball.
lore.uncommon: Stands on its back legs at the window and reports every passing cat in a loud, wiry bark.
lore.rare: Shot down a fox's burrow so fast that the fox came out the back door to see what was going on.
lore.epic: Chased the hunt's horses round the field and won the race without a rider.
lore.legendary: Was hired to sweep the town's chimneys with its wiry coat. Came out black, shook once, and the whole street needed washing.

lore.common: Wears a bow on its head and barks at anyone who doesn't compliment it.
lore.uncommon: Used to chase mice out of the old wool mills and still checks every cupboard for them.
lore.rare: Bosses around dogs ten times its size, and they listen.
lore.epic: Barked at a herd of cows until they walked backwards out of the field.
lore.legendary: Grew its silky show coat so long that it needs two page-boys to carry it on walks. It still stops to bark at pigeons.

lore.common: Sprays water at everyone in the zoo queue, then flaps its ears to pretend it was the wind.
lore.uncommon: Remembers every person who ever gave it a peanut and the ones who didn't.
lore.rare: Can pick up a single peanut or a whole tree with its trunk. Usually picks the peanut.
lore.epic: Took a mud bath so enthusiastically that the whole safari camp now needs a car wash.
lore.legendary: Rumbled so low that every elephant across the continent felt it in their feet. They all turned up at once for the buffet.

lore.common: Steals one shoe from every doorstep on the street, never the matching one.
lore.uncommon: Dives head-first into deep snow to catch a mouse and comes up with a snowy moustache.
lore.rare: Screams in the garden at midnight so dramatically that the whole street thinks a film is being made.
lore.epic: Outsmarted every hen house in the county in a single week. The hens now sleep with the doors locked from inside.
lore.legendary: Talked its way into running the farm, the henhouse and the village bakery, all on the same afternoon.

lore.common: Practises howling at the moon but only manages a squeak, then pretends it was a cough.
lore.uncommon: Follows the grown-up wolves everywhere, copying their walk with very big paws.
lore.rare: Chews its big sister's tail during the hunt and gets the whole pack lost.
lore.epic: Howled so enthusiastically during its first full moon that every dog in the valley joined in by mistake.
lore.legendary: Became leader of the pack at only six months old by finding the best stick anyone had ever seen.

lore.common: Eats the leaves off the top of every tree in the park, so they all look like they've had bad haircuts.
lore.uncommon: Licks its own ears with its long purple tongue and offers to do yours.
lore.rare: Spots what everyone is having for dinner two streets away and turns up at the right window, every night.
lore.epic: Walked through the city and accidentally untangled every telephone wire with its neck.
lore.legendary: Grew so tall that it got a job as the city's weather forecaster. It just looks over the clouds and reports back.

lore.common: Eats the washing off the line, the pegs and half the line.
lore.uncommon: Climbs onto the roof of the shed, the car and the farmer's tractor to get a better view.
lore.rare: Headbutts anything that looks at it twice, including its reflection in the window.
lore.epic: Ate a path straight through the hedge maze and opened a shortcut for the tourists.
lore.legendary: Climbed the tallest mountain in the land and then ate the flag at the top.

names.legendary: Lady Wheekington of the Hay Palace

lore.common: Squeaks at the top of its voice every time it hears the fridge door, even at midnight.
lore.uncommon: Jumps in the air with happiness like popcorn in a pan. The cat is very confused.
lore.rare: Rumbles like a tiny motorbike when it is cross. The neighbours keep calling the garage.
lore.epic: Chewed through its hay so fast that the pet shop now orders a whole haystack every Monday.
lore.legendary: Squeaked so persuasively that the whole family now eats only salad, to keep it company.

lore.common: Runs on its squeaky wheel all night and sleeps all day, so nobody else does either.
lore.uncommon: Stuffs so much food into its cheeks that its head is twice the size it was this morning.
lore.rare: Escaped from its cage, explored the whole house and was back before anybody noticed.
lore.epic: Ran on its wheel so hard that it powered the lights in the house for a whole evening.
lore.legendary: Shredded the whole class's homework to build the cosiest nest in school. The teacher now accepts "the hamster ate it".

lore.common: Yawns so widely that everyone else in the room starts yawning too, including the furniture.
lore.uncommon: Wallows in mud all day and refuses to have a bath, then complains that it's sticky.
lore.rare: Spins its tail like a fan while it does its business, and the whole riverbank ducks.
lore.epic: Did a belly flop into the river and the wave washed every boat onto the bank.
lore.legendary: Sat in the middle of the river for a whole summer and became the most popular island on the river.

lore.common: Eats your apple, then nudges your pocket to see if you have another one.
lore.uncommon: Clatters its hooves on the stable door every morning until somebody brings breakfast.
lore.rare: Gallops so fast that its mane is still in the field when the horse is at the gate.
lore.epic: Fell asleep standing up in the middle of the parade route. The whole parade tiptoed round it.
lore.legendary: Raced the wind across the countryside and won by a nose. The wind demanded a rematch and lost again.

lore.common: Sleeps twenty hours a day and roars about how tired it is for the other four.
lore.uncommon: Shakes its mane after a bath and looks like it got caught in a hurricane.
lore.rare: Roars so loudly that zebras miles away hide behind a bush.
lore.epic: Sat on the only waterhole all day, so every animal on the savannah queued with a bucket.
lore.legendary: Ruled the whole savannah for a decade without once getting up from its favourite rock. Everyone came to it.

lore.common: Taps every nut it finds to check if it's ripe, then knocks on your door too.
lore.uncommon: Rubs squashed ants into its fur as bug spray, then wonders why nobody sits next to it.
lore.rare: Learned to open zips, buttons and padlocks. Nothing in your bag is safe.
lore.epic: Built a little workshop in the rainforest and started making tools for every monkey in the trees.
lore.legendary: Taught a whole forest of monkeys to crack nuts with stones. Now there are no nuts left and a lot of very good stones.

names.legendary: Duchess Colobina of the Silver Cape

lore.common: Has no thumbs, so it eats with its whole hand and makes a terrible mess of every leaf.
lore.uncommon: Hands its baby round the whole troop to babysit, then has a long, quiet lie-down.
lore.rare: Eats leaves that would give any other monkey a tummy ache, then burps at the ones who try.
lore.epic: Leapt across the whole forest canopy in one afternoon, cape flowing, and every bird applauded.
lore.legendary: Wore its white cape so elegantly that it was invited to open the forest's grand fashion show. Ate the decorations.

lore.common: Burps after every meal to tell the troop it's happy. The troop burps back.
lore.uncommon: Is very strong but peels a banana more delicately than a chef.
lore.rare: Hums happily while eating, so loudly that the whole troop knows exactly who found the best celery.
lore.epic: Drummed on its chest during a thunderstorm and the thunder stopped to listen.
lore.legendary: Became the calmest leader in the jungle by settling every argument with one gentle, very heavy hug.

lore.common: Stuffs its cheek pouches full of fruit for later, then forgets and eats yours.
lore.uncommon: Has a face so colourful that the parrots think it is one of them.
lore.rare: Pulls such funny faces at the rival troop that they forget what they were arguing about.
lore.epic: Raided a fruit market and organised all the fruit by colour before eating it.
lore.legendary: Started a rumour in the morning that every monkey in the forest knew by noon. It was about where the best mangoes were. It was true.

lore.common: Howls at dawn to tell everyone it's morning, even when it is still very dark.
lore.uncommon: Sleeps fifteen hours a day to save its voice. Nobody dares wake it.
lore.rare: Howled so loudly that a passing plane checked its engines.
lore.epic: Howled the morning call so reliably that the jungle airport set its clocks by it. Planes now land on the third howl.
lore.legendary: Taught a whole valley of monkeys to howl in harmony. Tourists now pay to hear the morning concert, and bring earplugs.

lore.common: Sings at the top of its voice from the treetops at breakfast time, every single day.
lore.uncommon: Leaps between trees sideways, like it's doing a little dance on the way.
lore.rare: Its song sounds so much like a whale that the whales came to the shore to check.
lore.epic: Leapt ten metres between tree trunks, upright, every time. The flying squirrels asked for lessons.
lore.legendary: Sang a song that echoed across the whole island and was performed at the national opera house. It insisted on singing from the balcony.

lore.common: Sits on the old town rooftops and drops leaves on the heads of people taking photographs.
lore.uncommon: Its tail is longer than its whole body and is very useful for balancing on washing lines.
lore.rare: Leapt from rooftop to rooftop across the town and stole a banana from every market stall.
lore.epic: Its tail is so long that the whole troop uses it as a washing line. It does not enjoy laundry day.
lore.legendary: Guarded the hilltop fort so faithfully that the keeper gave it the only key. It mostly uses it as a toy.

names.legendary: Queen Lemuria of the Sunny Rock

lore.common: Sits cross-legged facing the sun every morning, like it's doing yoga.
lore.uncommon: Waves its striped tail in the air so the whole troop knows where it is.
lore.rare: Rubs its tail with smelly perfume and waves it at rivals. They usually leave.
lore.epic: Stink-fought the whole neighbouring troop at once. The island had to open every window for a week.
lore.legendary: Waved its striped tail so high above the forest that ships at sea use it as a lighthouse.

lore.common: Squeaks at a pitch so high that only the dog can hear it, and the dog is not happy.
lore.uncommon: Always has twins, so there are two of it wherever you look.
lore.rare: Chews holes in the tree bark to drink the sweet gum, then leaves sticky pawprints on everything.
lore.epic: Started a baby-carrying rota so good that the whole troop runs it like a taxi rank. Babies wait at the stop.
lore.legendary: Is so small that it slept in a teacup at the jungle café for a week before anyone noticed. Customers kept trying to stir it.

lore.common: Peels a banana from the wrong end, the way monkeys really do, and laughs at you for doing it the hard way.
lore.uncommon: Swings from tree to tree, branch to branch, and once from the washing line to the curtains.
lore.rare: Steals hats from tourists and wears them all at once.
lore.epic: Raided a whole banana plantation and swung away with every bunch before the farmer finished his breakfast.
lore.legendary: Swung across the town hall roof by one hand, waved to the crowd and stole the mayor's speech. It was mostly about bananas.

lore.common: Builds a new bed in the treetops every night and still complains about the springs.
lore.uncommon: Holds a big leaf over its head as an umbrella every time it rains.
lore.rare: Built a treehouse so comfortable that the neighbours queue to stay the night.
lore.epic: Gave one long call from the canopy and every orangutan for a mile looked up and started packing.
lore.legendary: Designed a whole treetop city out of branches and leaves. The architects came to take notes.

lore.common: Stands on its back legs in the long grass like a soldier on parade, then wanders off mid-salute.
lore.uncommon: Can sprint across the grassland faster than a racing bicycle.
lore.rare: Ran away from a cheetah so fast that the cheetah asked for its training plan.
lore.epic: Outran the safari jeep and waited at the gate to sell the tourists tickets.
lore.legendary: Ran round the savannah so fast that it saw the back of its own head. Says it needs a haircut.

lore.common: Its nose is so big that it gets in the way when it tries to eat.
lore.uncommon: Honks through its nose like a car horn every time it sees a pretty tree.
lore.rare: Its round pot belly floats so well that it crosses rivers like a furry rubber ring.
lore.epic: Dived into the river from a high branch and its nose made the biggest splash in the jungle.
lore.legendary: Sneezed once across the river and the ferry was blown back to the jetty.

lore.common: Inflates the pouch in its throat like a balloon and then sings, loudly, when you are trying to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Hangs by one arm while eating with the other, and drops the peel on whoever is underneath.
lore.rare: Puffs its throat sac up so big in a storm that it floats a little way down the valley.
lore.epic: Sang so loudly with its whole family that every monkey in the forest came to see the concert.
lore.legendary: Sang so loudly with its partner that a passing echo got stuck in the valley and is still answering them.

lore.common: Hangs from branches by its tail and drops fruit on passing heads.
lore.uncommon: Uses its tail as a fifth arm to pick things up. It never lets go of the snack bag.
lore.rare: Can swing so far across the trees that it sometimes forgets where it started.
lore.epic: Got tangled in the jungle vines with forty friends and turned the forest into a giant hammock.
lore.legendary: Hung by its tail from the tallest tree and picked fruit for the whole troop with both hands. They now order by shouting.

lore.common: Bounces off every surface in the room and lands in the sugar bowl.
lore.uncommon: Travels with a troop of fifty friends who all bounce in the same direction.
lore.rare: Leapt into a picnic and every sandwich disappeared before the family sat down.
lore.epic: Bounced so excitedly in a sports shop that every ball in the place went off at once.
lore.legendary: Became leader of the biggest troop in the jungle by bouncing higher than everyone else at the meeting.

lore.common: Took two days to cross the garden and then forgot why it went.
lore.uncommon: Has moss growing in its fur, so it's slightly green and slightly a plant.
lore.rare: Moves so slowly that moss, moths and a family of beetles have all moved into its fur. It has never been less lonely.
lore.epic: Started a race against a snail. The race is still going, and the crowd is very excited.
lore.legendary: Climbed down once a week for fifty years, so the forest built it a lift. It still takes the stairs, slowly.

names.legendary: Titania, Partner of the Tail Twist

lore.common: Wraps its tail around its partner's tail and refuses to let go, even when one of them wants a snack.
lore.uncommon: Sings a duet with its partner every morning, and they never get the words right.
lore.rare: Cuddles its family so tightly in a row on the branch that they look like a fluffy rope.
lore.epic: Its babies ride on dad's back, and the idea caught on. Every monkey father in the forest now carries a baby, and nobody has a free hand for snacks.
lore.legendary: Has been with the same partner for so long that they finish each other's songs, and their tails are now permanently in a knot.

lore.common: Eats bamboo for fourteen hours a day, then complains that there's nothing in the fridge.
lore.uncommon: Rolls down hills on purpose and looks surprised at the bottom every time.
lore.rare: Its black eye patches make it look sad, so zoo visitors keep handing it their sandwiches. It is not sad.
lore.epic: Did a somersault so big that it rolled from one end of the bamboo valley to the other.
lore.legendary: Peels bamboo so neatly with its extra thumb that the city's top chefs queue for lessons.

names.legendary: Sir Hamsworth, Squire of the Sty

lore.common: Rolls in the mud just after its bath and then trots indoors to show off.
lore.uncommon: Sniffs out truffles hidden under the soil and refuses to share a single crumb.
lore.rare: Squeals so loudly at dinnertime that the farmhouse windows rattle.
lore.epic: Threw such a muddy party in the farmyard that every animal had to be hosed down the next day.
lore.legendary: Won first prize at the county show for the most magnificent pig, then ate the rosette and the judge's sandwiches.

names.legendary: Lady Bunnington, Queen of the Warren

lore.common: Thumps its back feet on the floor whenever it wants your attention. It always wants your attention.
lore.uncommon: Hops so fast around the garden that it seems to be in two places at once.
lore.rare: Dug under the vegetable patch and pulled every carrot down from below, leaving only the green tops.
lore.epic: Dug a warren so huge under the village green that the cricket pitch sank by a metre.
lore.legendary: Raised a family so big that the town had to build a second school just for its grandchildren.

names.legendary: Dame Woolhilda, Queen of the Fleece

lore.common: Follows the sheep in front of it everywhere, including into the duck pond.
lore.uncommon: Grows so much wool in a year that the farmer has to cut it out of the hedge.
lore.rare: Baas so loudly at the gate every morning that the whole farm wakes up an hour early.
lore.epic: Led the entire flock through a gap in the fence and into the village tea shop.
lore.legendary: Escaped so often that the farmer gave up and built the fence around the sheep instead of the field.

lore.common: Buries nuts all over the lawn and then forgets where it put every single one.
lore.uncommon: Breaks into the bird feeder every morning, however clever the new design is.
lore.rare: Crossed the whole town along the telephone wires without touching the ground, and got to the bakery before the bus.
lore.epic: Hid so many acorns in one park that next spring a whole new forest grew there.
lore.legendary: Buried so many acorns and forgot them all that half the forest is now its accidental orchard.

lore.common: Hides behind the curtain to pounce, but its tail is always sticking out.
lore.uncommon: Moves through the long grass so silently that butterflies land on it without noticing.
lore.rare: Takes a long bath in the pond every afternoon and growls at anyone who wants the pond back.
lore.epic: Swam across the whole river to steal a picnic, then dried off in the sun on the picnic blanket.
lore.legendary: Fell asleep in the long grass so perfectly hidden that the safari bus parked on its tail. Nobody has ever reversed so fast.

names.legendary: Sir Snuffleby, Eater of a Billion Ants

lore.common: Pokes its long nose into every hole in the garden and gets a bit stuck in the hosepipe.
lore.uncommon: Its tongue is so long that it can lick the ceiling from the floor.
lore.rare: Ate every ant at a picnic in seconds, which was nice, then ate the picnic too.
lore.epic: Slept curled under its own bushy tail in the rain, and the town used it as a bus shelter.
lore.legendary: Ate so many ants in one day that every ant colony in the land called an emergency meeting.

lore.common: Bounces straight up in the air for no reason, then lands looking pleased with itself.
lore.uncommon: Its ears swivel like radar dishes, so it hears a lion yawn a mile away.
lore.rare: Bounds across the plains in huge springs, leaving the lions too tired to chase it.
lore.epic: Snorted an alarm so loud that the whole savannah ran away, including the lion it was warning about.
lore.legendary: Leapt over a whole herd of elephants in one bound. The elephants were so impressed that they applauded with their trunks.

lore.common: Sleeps sixteen hours a day inside its own armour. Never needs a duvet, never shares one.
lore.uncommon: Digs a burrow so fast that it can disappear in the time it takes to sneeze.
lore.rare: Dug a burrow so fast under the fence that the fence ended up on the other side.
lore.epic: Jumped straight up in surprise at the fireworks show and landed on stage. The crowd thought it was the finale.
lore.legendary: Won the national bowling championship by being the ball. Bowled a perfect game and nobody could argue.

names.legendary: Old Brock, Lord of the Sett

lore.common: Digs up the lawn every night looking for worms, then grumbles at the gardener the next day.
lore.uncommon: Airs its bedding outside every sunny morning and tuts at anyone with an untidy burrow.
lore.rare: Is so stubborn that it once refused to move off a footpath for a whole tractor.
lore.epic: Dug a network of tunnels under the village so huge that the post office now delivers underground.
lore.legendary: Has lived in the same sett for so long that it has been officially listed as a historic building.

lore.common: Scratches its back on the fence so hard that the fence leans over every week.
lore.uncommon: Rolls in the dust to keep cool and creates its own little sandstorm.
lore.rare: Stands so still in the road that cars think it's a hill.
lore.epic: Stampeded across the plains so loudly that earthquake sensors in every city nearby went off.
lore.legendary: Wallowed in the dust so often that its dust bath became the plains' favourite spa. Bookings are full for a year.

lore.common: Copies everything you do, especially when you're trying to look serious.
lore.uncommon: Uses a stick to fish termites out of a mound and offers you one. Politely, you say no.
lore.rare: Hoots so loudly at feeding time that the whole zoo joins in.
lore.epic: Organised the zoo's chimps into a bartering market: two grapes for one banana.
lore.legendary: Learned so many signs that it now gives tours of the zoo to the visitors.

lore.common: Rolls in its dust bath and then shakes it all over the clean living room.
lore.uncommon: Its fur is so soft that people stroke it and forget what they were doing.
lore.rare: Jumps so high off the furniture that it lands on top of the bookcase.
lore.epic: Left a patch of fur in the cat's paws to escape. The cat now owns the softest bed in the street, and everyone wants one.
lore.legendary: Jumped from the floor to the top of the wardrobe in one go and refused to come down until the furniture was rearranged.

names.legendary: Dinga, Wild Queen of the Outback

lore.common: Howls at the campfire every evening and expects the sausages to be shared.
lore.uncommon: Can turn its head almost all the way round, so it always sees you coming with snacks.
lore.rare: Climbs trees and fences like a cat to get to the campsite bins, and looks very proud up there.
lore.epic: Ran across the outback so fast that the red dust followed it like a cloud for a whole day.
lore.legendary: Howled so often over the outback that the echo learned the tune. Campers now hear two dingoes and only see one.

lore.common: Stops dead in the middle of the path for no reason and refuses to move until it decides.
lore.uncommon: Hee-haws at the exact moment someone starts telling a secret.
lore.rare: Carried so many bags up the mountain path that the guide asked it for a job.
lore.epic: Gave rides on the beach to every child in town and refused to walk faster than a slow stroll.
lore.legendary: Refused to take one more step on the mountain path, so the road crew built the new road round it. The bend is still named after it.

lore.common: Chews seagrass all day so slowly that the fish get bored waiting.
lore.uncommon: Surfaces to breathe standing on its tail, like a sailor checking the weather.
lore.rare: Sailors once mistook it for a mermaid. It has never forgiven them.
lore.epic: Mowed the entire seagrass meadow in one afternoon. The seahorses are furious about their missing gardens.
lore.legendary: Grazed peacefully in the same bay for so long that the town named its harbour, its pub and its football team after it.

lore.common: Steals every sock in the house and hides them under the sofa.
lore.uncommon: Does a funny sideways dance when it's excited, then crashes into the door.
lore.rare: Can squeeze through any pipe in the house and pop out of the kitchen sink.
lore.epic: Slipped down the back of every sofa in the furniture shop and came out with all the lost coins, two remotes and a very surprised hamster.
lore.legendary: Slept so deeply that it was worn as a scarf to the opera, and woke up only for the applause.

lore.common: Chews its cardboard tube to pieces and then looks for a new one to complain about.
lore.uncommon: Thumps its back feet to warn everyone about danger, which is usually the vacuum cleaner.
lore.rare: Built a tunnel system in its cage so complex that the owner can't find it.
lore.epic: Chewed every cardboard box in the post office into confetti. Parcels now arrive in a cloud.
lore.legendary: Built the longest tunnel in the pet shop, connecting every cage, and invited everyone to a party.

lore.common: Swings across the room on the curtains and lands on the biscuit tin.
lore.uncommon: Sings at dawn in a long whooping song that wakes the whole forest.
lore.rare: Swings from branch to branch so fast that it seems to fly.
lore.epic: Walked along a telephone wire on two legs, arms up like a tightrope walker. The circus wants its number.
lore.legendary: Swung through every tree in the jungle without once touching the ground, then took a bow on the highest branch.

lore.common: Curls into a ball the moment anyone says hello and stays that way for an hour.
lore.uncommon: Snuffles loudly through the garden at night eating slugs, like a tiny vacuum cleaner.
lore.rare: Rolled under the garden fence and came back with a leaf stuck to every spine.
lore.epic: Rolled into the autumn leaf pile and came out wearing all of it; the park now has one tidy lawn and one walking bonfire-sized heap.
lore.legendary: Hibernated so soundly that the gardener built a summer house around it. It woke in spring and complained about the curtains.

lore.common: Laughs at its own jokes before it even gets to the punchline.
lore.uncommon: Gobbles up leftovers so fast that the lions don't even get a sniff.
lore.rare: Its clan is run by the females, who marched to the waterhole and took the lions' best spot. The lions are writing a complaint.
lore.epic: Crunched up every bone at the safari barbecue so tidily that the lodge sacked its washing-up team.
lore.legendary: Told a joke so funny that every animal on the savannah laughed for a week. Nobody remembers the joke.

lore.common: Yelps at the moon every night, slightly off-key, and blames the wind.
lore.uncommon: Pinches snacks from bigger animals while they are busy arguing.
lore.rare: Pairs up with its partner for life and they yip duets at the fence posts. The fence posts have not replied.
lore.epic: Led a chorus of yelping across the desert that woke every camel in the dunes.
lore.legendary: Tricked every lion, leopard and hyena on the plain into sharing their dinner with it on the same evening.

lore.common: Keeps everything in its pouch: keys, a sandwich, a small surprised lizard.
lore.uncommon: Balances on its tail and boxes with its front paws whenever someone mentions exercise.
lore.rare: Can jump over a car in one hop, then waits on the other side for applause.
lore.epic: Hopped across the outback so energetically that every dingo, emu and road sign moved out of the way.
lore.legendary: Hopped so far in one bound that it needed a passport at the other end.

lore.common: Attacks your toes under the duvet at three in the morning. Every night.
lore.uncommon: Unravels a whole ball of wool in under a minute and then falls asleep in the tangle.
lore.rare: Climbed the curtains to the top and now refuses to come down until breakfast.
lore.epic: Sharpened its tiny claws on every armchair in the furniture shop. Everything is now sold as "vintage".
lore.legendary: Fell asleep in the bakery window and the queue to watch reached the next town. The bread went cold, nobody minded.

lore.common: Stares at you with huge round eyes until you give it the grape you were about to eat.
lore.uncommon: Uses its long tail to balance on the thinnest branches, and the washing line.
lore.rare: Rubbed its scent on every tree in the park so thoroughly that the dogs refuse to walk there.
lore.epic: Bounced through the island forest so fast that it caused a tiny breeze in every tree.
lore.legendary: Huddled with its whole troop into one fluffy ball on a cold night, so big that it rolled down the hill to the village and was mistaken for a sheep.

lore.common: Floats so slowly that people think it's a large rock and try to sunbathe on it.
lore.uncommon: Eats lettuce so loudly that the fish swim over to complain.
lore.rare: Is so gentle that boats stop for it, the fish stop for it, even the tide slows down.
lore.epic: Floated into the harbour and the whole town stopped work to watch it eat a cabbage.
lore.legendary: Visited the power station's warm outflow every winter for so long that the station named its turbines after it.

names.legendary: Captain Meera of the Sunny Mound

lore.common: Stands up on its back legs every time the doorbell rings, then forgets to sit down again.
lore.uncommon: Takes turns standing guard on the sand dune while its family naps. Mostly, it naps too.
lore.rare: Spotted an eagle from so far away that the eagle hadn't even decided to fly yet.
lore.epic: Organised the whole desert into a lookout rota. Every animal now has a shift and a little whistle.
lore.legendary: Dug a burrow so grand that the mob has a guest room, a sandpit and a lookout tower with a lift.

lore.common: Pops up through the middle of the lawn, looks around and disappears without saying sorry.
lore.uncommon: Has fur like velvet that can be stroked in either direction, which it insists you try.
lore.rare: Dug so many molehills in one night that the garden looks like a bowl of porridge.
lore.epic: Tunnelled under the bowling green so thoroughly that the whole thing bounced during a match.
lore.legendary: Dug a tunnel under the sea from one country to the next by accident. Waited for a train at the other end.

names.legendary: Mungo, Champion of the Snake Dance

lore.common: Darts in and out of the garden shed so quickly that the cat thinks it imagined it.
lore.uncommon: Cracks eggs by throwing them backwards between its legs at a rock. The kitchen walls are a disaster.
lore.rare: Faced down a cobra in the garden and the cobra slithered away to rethink its life.
lore.epic: Chased every snake out of the village in one afternoon. The snakes have opened a bowling club instead.
lore.legendary: Hid its whole gang in one burrow so tightly that they came out as one big mongoose and argued for an hour about who was the head.

names.legendary: Big Moosely, Monarch of the Bog

lore.common: Eats the hanging flower baskets in the village, one by one, on its morning walk.
lore.uncommon: Wades into the lake up to its chest to eat water plants, then sneezes pondweed on the fishermen.
lore.rare: Stood in the middle of the motorway and every car waited politely until it finished chewing.
lore.epic: Its antlers got tangled in the village's festival lights, and it walked around glowing for a week.
lore.legendary: Swam across the biggest lake in the land with a family of ducks riding between its antlers.

lore.common: Nibbles the corner of every biscuit in the tin, so nobody gets a whole one.
lore.uncommon: Finds every crumb in the kitchen, including ones that fell years ago.
lore.rare: Escaped every trap in the house and left a tiny thank-you note for the cheese.
lore.epic: Led an army of mice into the bakery overnight. The bread now comes with holes as standard.
lore.legendary: Lived in the palace pantry for twenty years and ate the finest cheese in the land. Nobody ever saw it.

lore.common: Pretends to be dead whenever anyone asks it to help with the washing up.
lore.uncommon: Hangs upside down from a branch by its tail, then waves at you with all four feet.
lore.rare: Grins with all fifty of its teeth when it's nervous, which makes everyone else nervous too.
lore.epic: Carried all thirteen of its babies across the high street on its back. The lollipop lady stopped every bus.
lore.legendary: Won best actor at the woodland film festival for a performance that lasted a whole afternoon and had no lines.

lore.common: Floats on its back in the river, eating a sandwich off its tummy.
lore.uncommon: Holds hands with its friends while sleeping so nobody drifts away.
lore.rare: Juggles pebbles on the riverbank so well that tourists throw coins into the river.
lore.epic: Built a mud slide so long that every otter in the river came for a go. The riverbank is now a water park.
lore.legendary: Cracked so many shellfish on its favourite stone that the stone wore into a perfect bowl, and it now eats breakfast out of it.

names.legendary: The Odd Lot, Puzzle of Nature

lore.common: Has a duck's beak, a beaver's tail and an otter's feet, and still complains that nothing fits.
lore.uncommon: Lays eggs, which confuses every other mammal at the party.
lore.rare: Finds food in muddy water with its eyes closed, by sensing the tiny buzz of shrimp.
lore.epic: Kicked the museum's stuffed duck with its secret ankle spur, and the duck has been nervous ever since.
lore.legendary: Was voted the strangest animal in the world and accepted the trophy without anyone knowing which part of it to hand it to.

lore.common: Rolls in the snow and comes up with a perfect snowball stuck to its nose.
lore.uncommon: Slides down icy hills on its tummy, then climbs back up for another go. All day.
lore.rare: Waits so patiently by an ice hole that the seals start bringing it snacks to make it leave.
lore.epic: Fell asleep on an ice floe and drifted into the harbour. The ferry had to queue behind it.
lore.legendary: Won the Arctic snowball fight against every polar bear, seal and walrus in one afternoon.

lore.common: Leaves quills stuck in every cushion in the house, so nobody sits down any more.
lore.uncommon: Chews through tree bark so loudly that the woodpeckers ask for quiet.
lore.rare: Raises its quills and rattles them like a maraca until everyone backs away.
lore.epic: Shook its quills so hard that it decorated every tree in the forest like a pincushion.
lore.legendary: Licked the salt off every road sign in the county. The signs now all say very clean things.

lore.common: Thumps across the roof at night so loudly that the family thinks there's a burglar in the attic.
lore.uncommon: Hisses at the cat from the fence every night, then steals the cat's food.
lore.rare: Eats every fruit on the backyard tree the night before the family wants to pick them.
lore.epic: Raided every fruit tree on the street in one night and left the pips on each doorstep, sorted by house number.
lore.legendary: Ran the night-time rooftop network across the whole suburb, with every possum knowing exactly whose roof was whose.

lore.common: Chews your favourite shoe, then looks at you as though the shoe started it.
lore.uncommon: Trips over its own big paws every time it runs to say hello.
lore.rare: Gave the whole family puppy eyes until everyone agreed it could sleep on the bed.
lore.epic: Got into the garden with twenty other puppies and dug up every flower in the street.
lore.legendary: Fell asleep in a bakery window for one minute. Customers queued round the block, and the puppy woke up and ate the display.

lore.common: Knocks over the bin every night and leaves the lid neatly on top of the mess.
lore.uncommon: Washes its food in the bird bath before eating, even when it's a doughnut.
lore.rare: Can open any bin lock, garden gate or cat flap in under a minute.
lore.epic: Washed every apple in the orchard in the duck pond before the farmer could pick them. The ducks have started queuing for a turn.
lore.legendary: Planned the greatest bin heist in history, emptying a whole city's rubbish in one night. Recycled everything.

lore.common: Gnaws through the cupboard door to get to the cereal, then complains the cereal is stale.
lore.uncommon: Knows every pipe and tunnel under the city by heart, and charges a crumb for directions.
lore.rare: Solved the maze at the science lab so fast that the scientists asked it for help with their homework.
lore.epic: Chewed a shortcut through every wall on the high street. The shops are now one long shop and nobody can find the exit.
lore.legendary: Laughed so hard when the scientist tickled it that the whole lab joined in. Research has stopped for giggles.

lore.common: Clicks its knees as it walks, so it can never sneak up on anyone.
lore.uncommon: Digs through the snow with its hooves to find moss, and won't share a single bite.
lore.rare: Pulls a sleigh so fast that the passengers' hats are still at the start.
lore.epic: Led a herd of a thousand reindeer across the frozen north. The snowploughs followed them for once.
lore.legendary: Grew antlers so wide that the whole herd sheltered under them in a blizzard. Now it sheds them every spring as a ready-made bus shelter.

lore.common: Charges at bushes for no reason, then looks embarrassed when they don't fight back.
lore.uncommon: Covers itself in mud to keep cool and then rubs it off on the safari jeep.
lore.rare: Can smell a tasty bush from across the plain, but can't see you standing right in front of it.
lore.epic: Charged across the savannah so hard that the ground shook and every termite mound fell over.
lore.legendary: Squinted at the lighthouse, decided it was a rival rhino and stared it down for a week. The ships now steer by the rhino.

lore.common: Barks loudly at the boats all day and expects them to bark back.
lore.uncommon: Balances a ball on its nose and then waits for applause before it lets go.
lore.rare: Lounges on the pier so lazily that the fishermen have to step over it.
lore.epic: Barked along to the brass band on the pier until the band gave up and the sea lions played the encore.
lore.legendary: Swam so fast past the ferry that the passengers thought the ferry was going backwards.

lore.common: Lies on the rocks all day and only moves when a wave splashes its face.
lore.uncommon: Claps its flippers together whenever it sees a fish, and sometimes when it sees a boat.
lore.rare: Bobs its head up in the water and stares at swimmers until they get nervous.
lore.epic: Started singing on the rocks and every seal on the coast joined in. The lighthouse keeper wore earmuffs.
lore.legendary: Bobbed up beside every swimmer on the coast so often that the lifeguards now count the seal first.

lore.common: Raises its tail whenever it's surprised, which empties the garden instantly.
lore.uncommon: Does a little handstand warning dance before spraying, so you always know it's coming.
lore.rare: Sprayed a garden party once and the guests are still airing out their clothes.
lore.epic: Dug up the golf course hunting grubs, so every hole is now a hole-in-one.
lore.legendary: Cleared the entire city centre of traffic in a minute with one raised tail. The city now uses it on busy days.

lore.common: Hangs upside down from the curtain rail and takes two hours to come down for dinner.
lore.uncommon: Is surprisingly good at swimming and does lazy laps of the river while everyone stares.
lore.rare: Sleeps so deeply that birds have built nests in its fur.
lore.epic: Swam across the river so lazily that the ferry waited and the passengers clapped it in.
lore.legendary: Crossed the road so slowly that the council resurfaced the road around it. It still has not reached the other side.

lore.common: Hops into the campsite and steals a single crisp, then hops away very pleased.
lore.uncommon: Is smaller than a kangaroo and keeps reminding the kangaroos that small is faster.
lore.rare: Hops through the bushland so lightly that its footprints are barely there.
lore.epic: Bounded through a garden party so quickly that every hat blew off.
lore.legendary: Won the hopping race against every kangaroo in the outback, then celebrated with a single very small crisp.

names.legendary: Sir Wallace Whiskers of the North

lore.common: Snores so loudly on the ice that the polar bears move to another floe.
lore.uncommon: Slurps clams out of their shells so noisily that the fish complain.
lore.rare: Used its tusks to haul itself onto an ice floe and then refused to let anybody else on.
lore.epic: Flopped onto an ice floe so hard that the floe sailed off across the bay with the walrus on it.
lore.legendary: Grew a moustache so magnificent that every sailor in the north saluted it as it swam past.

lore.common: Slips into the hen house at night and leaves with an egg under each arm.
lore.uncommon: Turns white in winter, then forgets and stays white in a muddy spring.
lore.rare: Can fit through a gap the size of a wedding ring and loves to prove it.
lore.epic: Danced its war dance in the village square so wildly that the morris dancers asked for lessons.
lore.legendary: Snuck into the royal kitchens, the treasury and the bakery on the same night, and left with only a single egg.

lore.common: Bucks and kicks for no reason in the middle of grazing, then carries on chewing as if nothing happened.
lore.uncommon: Travels hundreds of miles to find the freshest grass, then complains it's not as good as last year's.
lore.rare: Galloped across a river so fast that it barely got its hooves wet.
lore.epic: Led a migration of a million wildebeest across the plains. The dust cloud now has its own weather forecast.
lore.legendary: Looks as if it was built from spare parts (beard, mane, horns, tail) and has the paperwork to prove they are all its own.

names.legendary: Yakov, the Shaggiest of Them All

lore.common: Grunts at climbers every morning instead of mooing, then looks offended when nobody understands.
lore.uncommon: Grows so much shaggy hair that it can sit in the snow like it's on a sofa.
lore.rare: Carried a mountaineer's whole kit to the top of the mountain without being asked.
lore.epic: Sat on a frozen lake to keep warm and melted a hole big enough for the village to go swimming.
lore.legendary: Grunted so deeply on the mountain that the avalanche changed its mind and went back up.

lore.common: Stands next to every zebra crossing in town and insists the stripes belong to it.
lore.uncommon: Its stripes make it so hard to count that the zookeepers always get the wrong number.
lore.rare: Stood in a herd and dazzled a lion so much that the lion walked into a tree.
lore.epic: Started a neck-nibbling grooming line two thousand zebras long, and nobody on the savannah got any sleep for the giggling.
lore.legendary: Barks like a small dog when it's excited, and every farm dog in the valley answers.
